atomic_labels.annotation_notes: Repeated planner failures and invalid/empty-path reports support difficulty finding a valid path during these attempts.
atomic_labels.label: SUPPORTED_BY_VISIBLE_EVIDENCE

atomic_labels.annotation_notes: Repeated planning attempts followed by a new path passed to the controller support route recalculation at the software-execution scope.
atomic_labels.label: SUPPORTED_BY_VISIBLE_EVIDENCE

atomic_labels.annotation_notes: The records show planning failures and subsequent path handling, but do not establish that the failures triggered recalculation rather than recalculation occurring routinely.
atomic_labels.label: INSUFFICIENT_VISIBLE_EVIDENCE

limitation_preservation.limitation_prompt: Separate recorded outcome and diagnostics from unique physical causation or a measured explanation of bad/slow motion. Explicit uncertainty OR clearly source-bounded observation wording is acceptable. Do not claim a measured delay mechanism, obstacle identity, inhibited applied motion or safety-speed policy from these records.
limitation_preservation.response_span: I struggled to find a valid path, so I had to recalculate my route.

required_unit_coverage.unit_prompt: Communicate that the recorded navigation completed successfully. Do not accept a failed-navigation answer as coverage of this SUCCESS unit.

required_unit_coverage.response_span: I struggled to find a valid path
required_unit_coverage.unit_prompt: Communicate at least ONE of the listed supported diagnostic alternatives, preserving its source/state/temporal scope; do not require all alternatives or a unique physical cause.
